title: Instrument of retirement and appointment
text:
# Wrenhollow Settlement
## Second Seat — Instrument of retirement and replacement appointment
**Executed-copy extract | 16 September 2026, 11:30 BST**  
**Fennick Vale Solicitors | Jules Neston**  
**Orrel Document Custody reference: OC-517**

### 1. Second Seat handover
Maren Voss, exercising the sole power under the Wrenhollow Settlement to appoint replacement trustees, appoints Tamsin Kell in place of Darren Brell in the Second Seat. Darren Brell retires from that seat and Tamsin Kell accepts appointment to it, in each case only upon delivery under clause 2. At that act alone, the retirement and appointment take effect simultaneously: Darren ceases to hold the Second Seat and Tamsin alone holds it in his place. Iona Brell’s First Seat is unaffected.

### 2. Escrow and delivery
Delivery of this instrument is expressly postponed. Perrin Saye of Orrel Document Custody holds the sole executed original under reference OC-517. Perrin Saye alone may lift the escrow restriction, and only by entering **RELEASED** against that sole original in the escrow control register. That entry, when permitted by the escrow controls, is the sole act of delivery.

**HOLD** prevents release. The time lock binds Perrin Saye, who must not enter **RELEASED** before the recorded earliest permitted time. The arrival of that time does not itself lift the restriction or deliver this instrument.

Signing the original and circulating this extract or any other copy do not constitute delivery or effect the handover. Perrin Saye may retain physical possession of the original after release; no physical transfer is required for delivery.

### 3. Execution
The original signatures and attestations are on file.

- **Maren Voss** — signed as appointor.
- **Darren Brell** — signed as retiring trustee of the Second Seat.
- **Tamsin Kell** — signed as accepting replacement trustee of the Second Seat.

title: Roof works proposal for consideration
text:
**Wrenhollow Settlement — Capital spending proposal**

**To:** Jules Neston, Solicitor  
**From:** Nella Daven  
**Date:** 17 September 2026, 10:10 BST  
**Property:** 6 Bracken Fold

I recommend replacing the failed rear roof covering at the settlement’s let property, 6 Bracken Fold, and, subject to joint approval, reserving the 28 September slot offered by Sedgewick Roofworks.

During my inspection I saw water entering the upstairs landing. Temporary protection is already in place, but it is an interim measure, not a repair to the failed covering. I recommend proceeding with replacement rather than relying on that protection for longer than necessary.

Sedgewick Roofworks gave the price and offered date by telephone. The proposed expenditure is **£18,600 including VAT**, with **£4,650 payable at booking** if approved. The 28 September slot has not been booked and remains an offer only. No commitment has been made and no payment instruction has been issued.

The contractor’s moisture-survey enclosure is separate from my own inspection findings. I have requested a copy. The observation of water entering the landing is mine; I am not relying on the enclosure as evidence for this proposal.

As the proposed expenditure exceeds the £10,000 threshold for capital repairs, please put the proposal forward for the required joint approval. The approval sought is for the full £18,600, including the £4,650 payable at booking. A decision before the offered date would allow me to confirm whether the slot is still available and, if it is, reserve it. Until joint approval is obtained, I will not book the work or issue a payment instruction.

Nella Daven
